name: Taming the Beast
summary: In Razor Hill, Taming the Beast begins a young Horde hunter’s training with a taming rod. Thotar guides aspiring hunters as they face a vicious dire mottled boar.

sections.title: A Hunter's Rite of Passage
sections.body: Orc and Darkspear troll hunters in Durotar must learn to command the wild as well as survive it. Thotar, the veteran hunter trainer, gives young hunters an enchanted taming rod and sends them to face a fierce wild boar. They must subdue the beast without killing it, then make it a loyal ally.

sections.title: The Boars of Durotar
sections.body: Dire mottled boars roam the dry brush around Razor Hill. Their strength and temper make them a fitting first test for young hunters. The rod can subdue a charging boar, but using it takes patience and resolve, qualities every Horde tracker needs.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this trial?
faq.answer: The trial gives young hunters in Durotar their first practical lesson in using a taming rod to subdue a wild creature instead of killing it.
Thotar, the hunter trainer in Razor Hill, gives you this trial after you prove your basic survival skills across Durotar.

faq.q: Where are the dire mottled boars found?
faq.answer: Dire mottled boars roam the dry scrublands outside Razor Hill’s palisades in central Durotar.

faq.q: Do you keep the boar permanently after this quest?
aliases: is the boar my permanent pet
faq.answer: No. The boar you tame is practice and leaves when you return to Thotar. You continue training with other creatures before you form a lasting bond.
After you return to Thotar, he tests your command over other deadly Durotar predators, including surf crawlers and armored scorpid beasts.

faq.q: Why use a taming rod instead of pure instinct?
faq.answer: Novice hunters have not yet gained the spiritual and physical discipline to bond with beasts directly. The enchanted rod focuses their will on a wild beast’s spirit until they master the art.

angles.text: As a hunter, you begin learning the bond with animal companions that marks a master of beasts.
As an orc, you show strength of will by commanding a beast in Durotar’s harsh wilderness, your new home.
As a Darkspear troll hunter, you attune your spirit to Kalimdor’s rugged wildlife and continue your people’s ancient stalking traditions.
